name.description: Group calling line ID name. By default the org name.

phoneNumber.description: Directory Number / Main number in E.164 Format.

type.description: Webex Calling location API only supports setting `TRUNK` or `ROUTE_GROUP`.

id.description: A unique identifier of route type.

connection.description: Connection details can only be modified to and from local PSTN types of `TRUNK` and `ROUTE_GROUP`.

externalCallerIdName.description: External caller ID name value. Unicode characters.

pAccessNetworkInfo.description: Emergency Location Identifier for a location. The `pAccessNetworkInfo` is set only when the location's country is Belgium(`BE`), Germany(`DE`), or France(`FR`).

outsideDialDigit.description: Must dial to reach an outside line. Default is none.

enforceOutsideDialDigit.description: True when enforcing outside dial digit at location level to make PSTN calls.

routingPrefix.description: Must dial a prefix when calling between locations having same extension within same location, should be numeric.

chargeNumber.description: Set the chargeable number for the line placing the call.  When set and [useChargeNumberForPChargeInfo field (GET location)](/docs/api/v1/beta-location-call-settings-with-p-charge-info-support/get-location-webex-calling-details) is true for the location, all PSTN calls placed from this location will include a P-Charge-Info header with this specified number in the SIP INVITE.
